Hausa: Ƙwayar halittar matantaka, wanda kuma aka sani da estradiol, yana tasiri metabolism na ƙwayoyin sarrafa haila kuma yana canza metabolism na lipid.
Northern Sotho: Oseterotšene, yeo gape e tsebjago bjalo ka estradiol, e huetša tšhilego ya phrotšeseterone le go fetoša tšhilego ya liphiti.
Amharic: ኤስትራዲዮል በመባልም የሚታወቀው ኤስትሮጅን የፕሮጄስትሮን ሜታቦሊዝም ላይ ተጽእኖ የሚያደርግ ሲሆን የስብ ሜታቦሊዝምንም ይቀይራል።

Yoruba: Nípa èyí, ìgbéléwọ̀n gbọ́dọ̀ wà fún hòómónù tí a ṣẹ̀dá látara kọ̀lẹ́stírọ́ọ̀lù tí wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ kẹ́míkáàlì àti ìpele àyẹ̀wò tí ń ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n ọ̀rá àti kọ̀lẹ́stírọ́ọ̀lù fún àwọn aláìsàn jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke, ama-hormone e-steroid kanye namazinga wephrofayili ye-lipid ezigulini ezinomdlavuza webele kufanele ahlolwe.
Hausa: Don haka, dole ne a yi la’akari da matakan ƙwayoyin halittar steroid da matakan bayanin ga masu ciwon sankarar nono.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona, dikelo tša dihomoune tša seteroitse le phorofaele ya liphiti go balwetši ba kankere ya letswele di swanetše go lekolwa.

English: However, this has yet to be explored and used for therapy in Ethiopia.
Luganda: Wabula, kino tekinnanoonyerezebwako era tekinnakozesebwa mu kujjanjaba abalwadde mu ggwanga la Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀, kò tíì sí àwárí àti ìṣàmúlò wọn fún ìtọ́jú àìlera ní Ethiopia.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, lokhu akumele kuhlolwe futhi kusetshenziselwe ukwelashwa e-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, har yanzu ba a bincika wannan ba kuma ba a yi amfani da shi don jiyya a Habasha ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, go sa letilwe gore se se lekodišišwe le go šomišwa bjalo ka therapi go la Ethiopia.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ይህ ገና በኢትዮጵያ ለሚደረግ ህክምና መፈተሽ እና ጥቅም ላይ መዋል አለበት።

English: As a result, the present study at Tikur Anbessa Specialized Hospital attempted to assess serum oestrogen, progesterone, and lipid profile levels in breast cancer patients and healthy controls.
Luganda: Olw’ekyo, okunoonyereza kuno okwakolebwa mu Tikur Anbessa Specialized Hospital kwagezaako okwekaliriza obungi bwa oestrogen, ne progesterone mu lusaayisaayi n’obungi bw’ebirungo by’omu musaayi mu balwadde ba kookolo w’amabeere n’abo abalamu obulungi.
Yoruba: Nípa èyí, iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tí wọ́n ń ṣe lọ́wọ́ ní ilé-ìwòsàn tí wọ́n ń mójú tó irúfẹ́ àìsàn ńlá kan ní pàtó tí ó wà ní Tikur Anabessa gbìyànjú láti ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n sírọ́mù istirojíìnu, pirojẹstiróònù àti ìpele àyẹ̀wò tí ń ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n ọ̀rá àti kọ̀lẹ́stírọ́ọ̀lù ní ara àwọn aláìsàn jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn àti àwọn ìṣàkóso ìlera wọn.
Zulu: Ngenxa yalokho, ucwaningo lwamanje eSibhedlela Esikhethekile sase-Tikur Anbessa luzamile ukuhlola amazinga e-serum estrogen, progesterone, kanye ne-lipid ezigulini ezinomdlavuza webele kanye nokulawula okunempilo.
Hausa: Sakamakon haka, binciken da aka yi a Asibitin Musamman na Tikur Anbessa ya yi ƙoƙarin tantance matakan sinadarai na ƙwayar halittar matantaka, ƙwayoyin sarrafa haila, da bayanin lipid a cikin masu cutar sanakarar nono da kuma kula da lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona, dinyakišišo tša bjale Sepetleleng sa go Ikgetha sa Tikur Anbessa di lekile go lekola dikelo tša phorofaele ya oseterotšene ya seramo, phorotšeseterone, le liphiti go balwetši ba kankere ya letswele le ditaolo tša go phelega gabotse mmeleng.
Amharic: በዚህም ምክንያት አሁን ላይ ያለው ጥናት በጥቁር አንበሳ ስፔሻላይዝድ ሆስፒታል ሲረም ኤስትሮጅንን፣ ፕሮጀስትሮንን እና የስብ ፕሮፋይል መጠንን በጡት ካንሰር ታማሚዎች እና በጤነኛ መቆጣጣሪያ ቡድኖች ላይ ለማሰስ ሞክሮ ነበር።

English: A hospital-based comparative cross-sectional study was conducted on a total of 80 participants (40 newly diagnosed breast cancer patients and 40 healthy control females).
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okw’okugeraageranya okw’ekiseera ekimpi okwakolebwa mu ddwaliro kwakolebwa ku beetabi 80 omugatte (abalwadde 40 abapya abaazuulwamu kookolo w’amabeere n’abakyala abalala 40 abalamu obulungi).
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àfiwéra iṣẹ́ ìwádìí alákíìyèsí tí ó ń ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n ibi tí nǹkan da sí àti ibi tí o fì sí tí ó jẹ́ ti ajẹmọ́-ilé-ìwòsàn lórí àwọn olùkópa 80 (àwọn aláìsàn 40 tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀ dá àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ mọ̀ lára wọn àti àwọn obìnrin 40 tí wọ́n ní ìlera pípé).
Zulu: Ucwaningo olusekelwe ezibhedlela oluqhathanisekayo lwenziwa enanini labahlanganyeli abangama-80 (iziguli ezingama-40 ezisanda kutholwa ezinomdlavuza webele kanye nabesifazane abangama-40 bokulawula okunempilo).
Hausa: An gudanar da wani binciken kwatancen yanki na asibiti a kan jimlar mahalarta guda 80 (sababbin marasa lafiya ɗauke da sankarar nono guda 40 da kuma mata guda 40 masu kula da lafiya).
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tša papetšo tše di dirwago ka nako e tee go bakgathatema ba bantši tša sepetlele di dirilwe go palomoka ya bakgathatema ba 80 (balwetši ba kankere ya letswele bao ba sa tšwago go hlahlobja ba 40 le basadi bao ba phelegilego gabotse mmeleng ba 40).
Amharic: ሆስፒታል ላይ የተመሰረተ አወዳዳሪ ሰፊ የክፍል በክፍል ጥናት በ80 ተሳታፊዎች ላይ ተደርጎ ነበር (40 አዲስ ተመርምረው የታወቁ የጡት ካንሰር በሽተኞች እና 40 ጤነኛ የመቆጣጠሪያ ሴቶች)።

English: A convenient sampling method was used to recruit the study participants.
Luganda: Okweroboza okw’okulonda abeetabi abafunika kwakozesebwa okulonda abeetabi abaakozesebwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Yoruba: Ìlàna kan tí ó rọrùn fún ìṣàgbéyẹ̀wò ni wọ́n fi gba àwọn olùkópa tí wọ́n fẹ́ fi ṣe ìwádìí náà.
Zulu: Kusetshenziswe indlela ekahle yokusampula ukuze kubuthwe ababambiqhaza bocwaningo.
Hausa: An yi amfani da hanyar da ta dace domin ɗaukar mahalarta binciken.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe mokgwa o mokaone wa go sampole go laletša bakgathatema ba dinyakišišo.

English: Steroid hormones and lipid profile were determined using immunoassays and an enzymatic colorimetric technique, respectively.
Luganda: Obungi bwa homoni obutali bwa butonde bwazuulibwa okuyita mu nkola ey’okukebera omusaayi olwo obungi bw’ebirungo by’omu musaayi ne buzuulibwa okuyita mu nkola ey’okwekaliriza enkyukakyuka ya langi ekolebwa enzayimu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò pẹ̀lú ìlò àyẹ̀wò ìwọ̀n nípa ìdámọ̀ bí ántíjẹ́ẹ̀nì ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ lòdì sí nínú ara àti àwọn hòmóònù tí a ṣẹ̀dá látara kọ̀lẹ́stírọ́ọ̀lù tí wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ kẹ́míkáàlì nínú ara àti àyẹ̀wò ìlànà ṣíṣàwárí nǹkan nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìlò kẹ́míkáàlì tí ó ní ṣe pẹ̀lú ìyípadà àwọ̀, lẹ́sẹẹsẹ.
Zulu: Amahomoni e-steroid kanye nephrofayili ye-lipid kwanqunywa kusetshenziswa ama-immunoassays kanye nendlela ye-enzymatic colorimetric, ngokulandelana.
Hausa: An ƙaddara ƙwayoyin halittar steroids da bayanin lipid ta hanyar amfani da gwajin abubuwan cikin jini da fasaha mai launi na enzymatic, bi-a-bi.
Northern Sotho: Dihomoune tša seteroitse le phorofaele ya liphiti di laeditšwe ka tšhomišo ya diimunoaseyi le thekniki ya khalorimetheriki ya diensaeme, ka go latelana.
Amharic: ስቴሪዮድ ሆርሞኖች እና የስብ ፕሮፋይል ፣ የበሽታ መከላከያ ምርመራዎችን እና የኢንዛይም ከለሪሜትሪክ ዘዴን በቅደም ተከተል በመጠቀም ተለይተው ወጥተው ነበር።

English: SPSS version 20.0 was used for statistical analysis, and p-values of 0.05 were considered statistically significant.
Luganda: SPSS olufulumya 20.0 yakozesebwa mu kukola okwekaliriza okw’ebibalo era emiwendo-p mu bungi bwa 0.05 egyoleka obusobozi bw’ekiteeberezo ekikyamu okutuukirira gyali mingi nnyo.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀dà SPSS 20.0 ni wọ́n lò láti fi ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n ìṣirò àti 0.05 fáàfù-P ni wọ́n gbé yẹ̀wò tí wọ́n ri pé ó ní ipa ìṣirò.
Zulu: Inguqulo engu-20.0 ye-SPSS isetshenziselwe ukuhlaziywa kwezibalo, futhi amanani we-p ka-0.05 abhekwa njengokubalulekile ngokwezibalo.
Hausa: An yi amfani da sigar SPSS 20.0 don ƙididdigar nazarin, kuma darajar-p 0.05 an yi la'akari da ƙididdiga masu mahimmanci.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe bešene ya 20.0 ya SPSS go dira tshekatsheko ya dipalopalo, ebile p-values tša 0.05 di bonwe bjalo ka tše bohlokwa mererong ya dipalopalo.
Amharic: SPSS ስሪት 20.0 ለስታስቲካዊ ትንተና ጥቅም ላይ የዋለ ሲሆን 0.05 የፒ-ውጤቶች ስታስቲካዊ ጥቅም እንዳላቸው ታሳቢ ተደርጎ ነበር።

English: When compared to healthy controls, the mean serum progesterone, TC, and HDL-C levels in breast cancer patients were considerably lower, while estradiol, TG, and LDL-C levels were insignificantly higher.
Luganda: Bw’ogeraageranya n’abeetabi abaali abalamu, omukkati gw’obungi bwa progesterone, TC, ne HDL-C mu lusaayisaayi lw’abalwadde ba kookolo w’amabeere gwali wansi nnyo, olwo ate obungi bwa estradiol, TG, ne LDL-C ne buba nga bwali waggulu nnyo.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí wọ́n fi wé àwọn ìṣàkóso ìlera, sìrọ́mù pirojẹstiróònù tí ó le, TC, àti ìpele HDL-C ní ara àwọn aláìsàn jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn lọ lẹ̀, tí ẹ̀dà hòmóònù istirojíìnù, TG, àti ìpele LDL-C sì gá láì nípa.
Zulu: Uma kuqhathaniswa nezilawuli ezinempilo, amazinga amaphakathi e-serum progesterone, TC, kanye ne-HDL-C ezigulini ezinomdlavuza webele ayephansi kakhulu, kuyilapho amazinga e-estradiol, TG, kanye ne-LDL-C ayephezulu kakhulu.
Hausa: Idan aka kwatanta da kulawar lafiya, ma’anar maganin ƙwayoyin sarrafa haila, TC, da HDL-C a cikin marasa lafiya da ciwon sankarar nono sun yi ƙasa sosai, yayin da matakan estradiol, TG, da LDL-C ba su da mahimmanci.
Northern Sotho: Ge di bapetšwa le ditaolo tša seemo sa go phelega gabotse mmeleng, kelo ya fasana ya phorotšeseterone ya seramo, TC, le dikelo tša HDL-C go balwetši ba kankere ya letswele di bi le fasana kudu, mola estradiol, TG, le dikelo tša LDL-C di bile godingwana gannyane.

English: A study from Ethiopia shows that women who have recently been diagnosed with breast cancer have lower levels of hormones and other substances in their blood.

English: Researchers say that this important information could be used to help doctors identify and treat breast cancer early in places where the disease is often diagnosed too late, like Ethiopia.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti obubaka buno obw’omuwendo busobola okukozesebwa okuyamba abasawo okuzuula n’okujjanjaba kookolo w’amabeere nga bukyali mu bitundu abantu mwe balwirawo ddala okukebera endwadde eno, gamba nga mu Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àlàyé pàtàkì yìí lè wúlò láti ran àwọn dọ́kítà lọ́wọ́ láti tètè dá jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn mọ̀ àti tọ́jú rẹ̀ ní àwọn ibi tí wọn kìí tètè dá àìsàn náà mọ̀, bíi Ethiopia.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi lolu lwazi olubalulekile lungasetshenziswa ukusiza odokotela bakwazi ukubona nokwelapha umdlavuza webele kusenesikhathi ezindaweni lapho lesi sifo sivame ukutholakala sekwephuze kakhulu, njenge-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce za a iya amfani da wannan muhimmin bayani domin taimakawa likitoci su gano tare da magance cutar sankarar nono da wuri a wuraren da ake yawan gano cutar da wuri, kamar Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore tshedimošo ye e bohlokwa e ka šomišwa go thuša dingaka go lemoga le go alafa bolwetši bja kankere ya letswele e sa ka pela mafelong ao bolwetši gantši bo lemogwago morago ga nako, go swana le Ethiopia.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚሉት ይህ ወሳኝ መረጃ በሽታው በጣም ከረፈደ በኋላ በሚታወቅባቸው እንደ ኢትዮጵያ ባሉ ሃገራት ዶክተሮች የጡት ካንሰርን በጊዜ ለይተው እንዲያውቁ እና እንዲያክሙ ጥቅም ላይ ሊውል ይችላል።

English: Breast cancer is a common disease worldwide and responsible for many deaths, especially in developing countries where cases often aren’t diagnosed soon enough.
Luganda: Kookolo w’amabeere ndwadde esaasaanye mu ensi yonna era ng’etta abantu bangi, naddala mu mawanga agakyakula mwe tulaba ng’abantu abagirina tebatera kwekebeza nga bukyali.
Yoruba: Jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn jẹ́ àrùn tó wọ́pọ̀ kárí-ayé tí ó sì ti pa àwọn èèyàn púpọ̀, àgàgà ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ìdàgbàsókè ṣì ń bá tí wọn kìí tètè dá àìsàn mọ̀ lára àwọn tí wọ́n ní àìsàn náà.
Zulu: Umdlavuza wamabele uyisifo esivamile emhlabeni wonke futhi esibangela ukufa kwabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi emazweni asathuthuka lapho izimo ngokuvamile zingatholakali ngokushesha ngokwanele.
Hausa: Ciwon sankarar nono cuta ce da ta zama ruwan dare gama-duniya kuma tana da alhakin mutuwar mutane da yawa, musamman a ƙasashe masu tasowa inda galibi ba a gano cutar da wuri.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bja kankere ya letswele ke bolwetši bjo tlwaelegilego kudu lefaseng ka bophara ebile bo rwele maikarabelo go mahu a mantši, kudukudu ka dinageng tše di hlabologago moo malwetši a sa lemogwego e sa le nako.

English: The earlier doctors can diagnose the disease, the better the chances of survival.
Luganda: Abasawo gye bakoma okuzuula endwadde eno mu bwangu, n’emikisa gy’okusimattuka gye gikoma okweyongera.
Yoruba: Bí ó bá ṣe yá àwọn dọ́kítà sí láti dá àìsàn náà mọ̀ lára, máa níṣe pẹ̀lú bí yíye àrùn náà ṣe máa wà sí.
Zulu: Odokotela bangaphambi kwesikhathi bangasihlonza lesi sifo, aba ngcono amathuba okusinda.
Hausa: Gano cutar da wuri daga likitocin, ita ce mafi kyawun damar rayuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ge dingaka di ka le lemoga bolwetši e sa le ka pela, go na le dibaka tše kaone tša go phologa.

English: Since changes in hormones and lipids (fats) in the blood are not currently used to help diagnose breast cancer in Ethiopia, researchers wanted to compare the amount of these substances in the blood of women with breast cancer to the amounts in blood samples from healthy women.
Luganda: Engeri gye kiri nti enkyukakyuka mu homoni n’amasavu agabeera mu musaayi tebikozesebwa kaakano mu kukebera kookolo w’amabeere mu ggwanga lya Ethiopia, abanoonyereza baayagala okugeraageranya omuwendo gw’ebirungo bino mu musaayi gw’abakyala abalina kookolo w’amabeere n’obungi bwabyo mu sampolo z’omusaayi gw’abakyala abatamulina.
Yoruba: Níwọ̀n ìgbà tí àwọn ìyípadà kan nínú hòmóònù àti irúfẹ́ ọ̀rá (ọ̀rá) nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ ò sí fún ìlò ìdámọ̀ àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn ní Ethiopia nísìnyìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ lo ìfiwéra bí nǹkan wọ̀nyìí ṣe pọ̀ tó nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n ní àrùn jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn sí iye tí ó wà nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí wọ́n gbà lára àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n wà ní ìlera.
Zulu: Njengoba izinguquko kuma-hormone nama-lipids (amafutha) egazini zingasetshenziselwa ukusiza ukuxilonga umdlavuza webele e-Ethiopia, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqhathanisa inani lalezi zinto ezisegazini labesifazane abanomdlavuza webele nenani elitholakala kumasampula egazi kwabesifazane abanempilo.
Hausa: Tunda a halin yanzu ba a amfani da sauye-sauye a cikin ƙwayoyin halitta da lipids (fats) a cikin jini domin taimakawa wajen gano cutar sankarar nono a Habasha, masu binciken sun so su kwatanta adadin waɗannan abubuwa a cikin jinin mata masu ciwon sankarar nono da adadin samfuran jini daga mata masu lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge diphetogo go dihomoune le diliphiti (makhura) ka mading gabjale di sa šomišwe go thuša go lemoga kankere ya letswele go la Ethiopia, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go bapetša kelo ya ditšweletšwa tše ka mading a basadi bao ba nago le bolwetši bja kankere ya letswele le dikelo tša disampole tša madi go tšwa go basadi bao ba phelegilego gabotse mmeleng.
Amharic: በአሁኑ ጊዜ በሆርሞኖች እና በስቦች (ቅባቶች) ላይ ያለው ለውጥ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ የጡት ካንሰርን መኖሩን ለማወቅ ስለማያግዙ ተመራማሪዎች በደም ውስጥ የእነዚህን ንጥረ ነገሮች መጠን የጡት ካንሰር ካለባቸው ወጣት ሴቶች የደም ናሙናዎች ውስጥ ካለው መጠን ጋር ማወዳደር ፈልገው ነበር።

English: They reasoned that if there were differences, this information could help medical staff find breast cancer sooner.
Luganda: Baalowooza nti singa kinaasangibwa nga waliwo enjawulo, obubaka buno buyinza okuyamba abeebyobulamu okuzuula kookolo w’amabeere mu bwangu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rò ó pé tí ìyàtọ̀ bá wà, àlàyé yìí lè ran àwọn oníṣèwòsàn òyìnbó lọ́wọ́ láti tètè ṣàwárí jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn.

Northern Sotho: Ba fahletše ka gore ge go be go na le go fapana, tshedimošo ye e ka thuša bahlankedi ba kalafo go lemoga bolwetši bja kankere ya letswele e sa le nako.
Amharic: መላምታቸው ይህ መረጃ የህክምና ባለሞያዎች የጡት ካንሰርን ፈጠን ብለው እንዲያገኙ ይረዳቸው ይሆናል የሚል ነው።

English: The researchers took blood samples from 80 women.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baafuna sampolo z’omusaayi okuva ku bakyala 80.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí gba ẹ̀jẹ̀ lára àwọn obìnrin 80.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathathe amasampula egazi kwabesifazane abangu-80.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ɗauki samfurin jini daga mata guda 80.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tšere disampole tša madi go tšwa basading ba 80.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከ80 ሴቶች የደም ናሙናዎችን ወስደው ነበር።

English: Half of the women had just been diagnosed with breast cancer, and the other half were healthy.

Northern Sotho: Seripagare sa basadi ba be ba sa tšwa go phekolwa gore ba na le bolwetši bja kankere ya letswele, mola seripagare se sengwe ba be ba phelegile gabotse.
Amharic: ግማሾቹ ሴቶች ገና የጡት ካንሰር እንደያዛቸው ተመርምረው ያወቁ ሲሆን የቀሩት ግማሾቹ ደግሞ ጤነኛ ነበሩ።

English: They also collected information about each woman, such as her weight, age, and whether she had experienced menopause (the end of menstruation).

Zulu: Baqoqa nokwaziswa ngowesifazane ngamunye, njengesisindo sakhe, ubudala, nokuthi wayeke wanqamuka yini ukuya esikhathini (ukuphela kokuya esikhathini).
Hausa: Sun kuma tattara bayanai game da kowace mace, kamar nauyinta da shekarunta, da kuma ko ta sami daina al'ada (ƙarshen haila).
Northern Sotho: Ba kgobokeditše le tshedimošo ka ga mosadi yo mongwe le yo mongwe, e bjalo ka boima, mengwaga le ge e ba o emišitše go bona lehlapo (mafelelo a go bona lehlapo).
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ስለእያንዳንዷ ሴት ክብደት፣ እድሜ እና አርጣ እንደሆነ (የወር አበባ መቆም) የሚገልጹ መረጃዎችን ሰብስበዋል።

English: The researchers then took the blood samples and tested them to see how much of certain fats, like cholesterol, and hormones were in them.
Luganda: N’oluvannyuma abanoonyereza baatwala sampolo z’omusaayi era ne bazikebera okulaba obungi bw’amasavu agaazirimu gamba ng’amasavu g’omubiri n’obusimu.
Yoruba: Nígbà náà ni àwọn aṣèwádìí mú àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí wọ́n gbà náà tí wọ́n sì ṣe àyẹ̀wò wọn láti rí bí àwọn ọ̀rá kọ̀ọ̀kan ṣe pọ̀ tó, bí kọ̀lẹ́stírọ́ọ̀lù àti hòmóònù tí ó wà nínú wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babe sebethatha amasampula egazi bawahlola ukuze babone ukuthi angakanani amafutha athile, njenge-cholesterol, namahomoni akuwo.
Hausa: Daga nan ne masu binciken suka ɗauki samfurin jinin sannan suka gwada su don ganin yawan wasu kitse, kamar cholesterol, da ƙwayoyin halitta da ke cikinsu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tšere disampole tša madi ba dira diteko ka ona go bona gore a na le kelo ye kaakang ya makhura, a bjalo ka kholeseterole, le dihomoune go ona.
Amharic: በመቀጠል ተመራማሪዎቹ የደም ናሙናዎችን ወስደው ምን ያህል የተወሰኑ እንደ ኮሌስትሮል እና ሆርሞኖች ያሉ ቅባቶች ውስጣቸው እንዳሉ መርምረዋል።

English: For example, they looked at levels of reproductive hormones, like progesterone, which scientists already know are connected to how breast cancer develops in the body.
Luganda: Okugeza, baatunuulira obungi bw’obusimu obuzaazi, gamba ng’obusimu bwa progesterone, bannassaayansi ze bamanyi obulungi nti zeekuusa ku ngeri kookolo w’amabeere gy’ajjamu mu mubiri.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, wọ́n wo àwọn ìpele hòmóònù ìbí, bíi pirojẹstiróònù, tí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì ti mọ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ pé wọ́n ní ìbásepọ̀ pẹ̀lú bí jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn ṣe ń dàgbà sí nínú ara.
Zulu: Isibonelo, babheke amazinga amahomoni okuzala, njenge-progesterone, ososayensi asebeyazi kakade ukuthi axhumene nendlela umdlavuza webele okhula ngayo emzimbeni.
Hausa: Alal misali, sun kalli matakan ƙwayoyin halitta na haihuwa, kamar ƙwayoyin sarrafa haila, wanda masana kimiyya suka rigaya sun sani suna da alaƙa da yadda ciwon sankarar nono yake tasowa a cikin jiki.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, ba lebeletše dikelo tša dihomoune tša pelego, go swana le phorotšeseterone, tšeo ditsebi tša saentshe di šetšego di tseba gore di amantšhwa le ka moo kankere ya letswele e golago ka gona mmeleng.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ሳይንቲስቶች ቀድሞውኑ ከጡት ካንሰር የሰውነት ውስጥ አከሳሰት ጋር እንደሚዛመዱ የሚያውቋቸው እንደ ፕሮጄስትሮን ያሉ የመራቢያ ሆርሞኖችን መጠኖች አይተዋል።

English: They also compared their results to “reference ranges”, which are the amounts of these substances that should be in healthy blood according to medical science.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baageraageranya bye baazuula n’emiwendo egijulizibwako, nga gino giba miwendo egyoleka obungi bw’ebirungo bino obulina okubeera mu musaayi gw’omuntu omulamu okusinziira ku ssaayansi w’endwadde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe àfiwéra èsì ìdánwò wọn sí “àwọn ìgbéléwọ̀n tí dọ́kítà fi ń túmọ̀ èsì àyẹ̀wò aláìsàn”, tí wọ́n jẹ́ iye ohun kan tí ó yẹ kí ó wà nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí ó ní ìlera ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú ìṣewòsàn sáyẹ́nsì.
Zulu: Baphinde baqhathanisa imiphumela yabo “nobubanzi bereferensi”, okungamanani alezi zinto okufanele zibe segazini elinempilo ngokwesayensi yezokwelapha.
Hausa: Sun kuma kwatanta sakamakonsu zuwa “zangunan lafiya”, wanda shi ne adadin waɗannan abubuwan da yakamata su kasance cikin lafiyayyen jini bisa ga ilimin likitanci.
Northern Sotho: Ba bapeditše le dipoelo tša bona le/go “bogolo bja boikgakollo”, tšeo e lego dikelo tša ditšweletšwa tše tšeo di swanetšego go ba ka mading ao a hlwekilego go ya ka saentshe ya tša kalafo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ውጤቶቻቸውን ”ከማጣቀሻ ክልሎች“ ጋር ያወዳደሩ ሲሆን እነዚህም ሜዲካል ሳይንስ እንደሚለው በጤነኛ ደም ውስጥ መገኘት ያለባቸው የንጥረ ነገሮች መጠኖች ናቸው።

English: The researchers found that women with breast cancer had much less progesterone in their blood, as well as less of some types of fat, when compared to healthy women and reference ranges.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula ng’abakyala abalina kookolo w’amabeere baalina ekirungo kya progesterone kitono nnyo mu musaayi gwabwe, kw’ossa okubeera n’ebika by’amasavu ebimu nga bitono, bw’ogeraageranya n’abakyala abalamu obulungi n’emiwendo egijulizibwako.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí ri pé àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n ní jẹjẹrẹ yìí ò ní pirojẹstiróònù púpọ̀ nínú ẹ̀jè wọn, àti pé, wọn ò ní irúfẹ́ àwọn ọ̀rá kan tí ó pọ̀ lára tí a bá fi wé ti àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n ní ìlera tó péye àti àwọn ìgbéléwọ̀n tí dọ́kítà fi ń túmọ̀ èsì àyẹ̀wò aláìsàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi abesifazane abanomdlavuza webele babene-progesterone encane kakhulu egazini labo, kanye nezinhlobo ezithile zamafutha amancane, uma beqhathaniswa nabesifazane abanempilo kanye nezinhla zokubhekisela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa matan da suke fama da ciwon sankarar nono suna da ƙarancin ƙwayoyin sarrafa haila a cikin jininsu, da kuma ƙarancin wasu nau’o’in kitse, idan aka kwatanta su da mata masu lafiya da kuma zangunan lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore basadi bao ba nago le kankere ya letswele ba be ba na; e phorotšeseterone ye nnyane mading a bona, gammogo le kelo ya fasana go mehuta ye mengwe ya makhura, ge go bapetšwa le basadi bao ba phelegilego gabotse le bogolo bja boikgakollo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳገኙት ከጤነኛ ሴቶች እና ከማጣቀሻ ክልሎች ጋር ሰወዳደሩ የጡት ካንሰር ያለባቸው ሴቶች በደማቸው ውስጥ አነስተኛ የፕሮጄስትሮን መጠን እንዲሁም አነስተኛ የተወሰኑ የቅባት አይነቶች ያላቸው ናቸው።

English: They also saw that, in most cases, other differences, like age, weight and whether the women were in menopause, didn’t change the results.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baakiraba nti, ebiseera ebisinga, enjawulo endala, gamba ng’emyaka, obuzito awamu n’okuba oba ng’abakyala tebakyagenda mu nsonga, tezaakyusanga bivaamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé, púpọ̀ lára wọn, àwọn ìyàtọ̀ míràn, bí ọjọ́ orí, bí wọ́n ṣe tóbi sí àti bóyá àwọn obìnrin yìí ti wọ ìpele ìdádúró nǹkan oṣù wọn, ò mú àyípadà bá èsì ìdánwò náà.
Zulu: Baphinde babona ukuthi, ezimweni eziningi, okunye ukuhluka, okufana neminyaka, isisindo kanye nokuthi ngabe abesifazane basesikhathini sokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini, akuzange kushintshe imiphumela.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun ga cewa, a mafi yawan lokuta, wasu bambance-bambance, kamar shekaru da nauyi da kuma ko matan sun kasance a cikin daina al’ada, ba su canza sakamakon ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile le gore, mabakeng a mantši, dipharologantšho tše dingwe, tše bjalo ka mengwaga, boima le ge e ba basadi ba be ba fihlile seemong sa go emišwa ga lehlapo, ga se tša fetoša dipoelo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በአብዛኛዎቹ ክስተቶች እንደ እድሜ፣ ክብደት እና ሴቶቹ ያረጡ ወይም ያላረጡ መሆናቸውን ያሉ ለውጦች ውጤቱን አልቀየሩትም።

English: Their findings show that breast cancer could be responsible for the changes they saw, and that tests for hormones and fat levels in the blood may be used to check for the disease.
Luganda: Bye baazuula biraga nti kookolo w’amabeere yandiba nga y’aviirako enkyukakyuka ze baalaba, era ng’okukebera obungi ba homoni n’amasavu mu musaayi kusobola okukozesebwa okukebera endwadde.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí wọn fi hàn pé jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn lè ṣokùn fa ìyípadà tí wọ́n rí, tí ó sì ń ṣe àyẹ̀wò fún hòmóònù àti ìpele ọ̀rá nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí wọ́n lè fi yẹ àrùn náà wò.
Zulu: Abakutholile kukhombisa ukuthi umdlavuza webele ungaba yimbangela yezinguquko abazibonayo, kanti ukuhlolwa kwamahomoni namafutha egazini kungase kusetshenziswe ukuhlola lesi sifo.
Hausa: Binciken da suka yi ya nuna cewa ciwon sankarar nono zai iya haifar da sauye-sauyen da suka gani, kuma ana iya amfani da gwaje-gwaje na ƙwayoyin halitta da matakan kitse a cikin jini domin bincika cutar.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo tša bona di laetša gore bolwetši bja kankere ya letswele bo ka rwala maikarabelo go diphetogo tšeo ba di bonego, le gore diteko tša dikelo tša dihomoune le tša makhura ka mading di ka šomišwa go nyakana le bolwetši.
Amharic: ግኝቶቻቸው እንደሚያሳዩት የጡት ካንሰር ላገኟቸው ለውጦች ተጠያቂ ሊሆን ይችላል እንዲሁም በደም ውስጥ ለሆርሞን እና ለቅባት መጠኖች የተደረጉ ምርምሮች በሽታው መኖር አለመኖሩን ለመፈተሽ ጥቅም ላይ ሊውሉ ይችላሉ።

English: The researchers said their results match what many other researchers have found, but they added that some other studies showed no changes in the amounts of fats and hormones.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bye baazuula bikwatagana n’ebyo abanoonyereza abalala bangi bye bazudde, naye ne bongerako nga bagamba nti okunoonyereza okulala okumu kwalaga nga tewali nkyukakyuka zonna ziriwo mu bungi bw’amasavu n’obwo oba homoni.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé èsì wọn bah ohun tí àwọn aṣèwádìí púpọ̀ tó kù ti rí, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ṣàfikún pé àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí míràn ò ṣàfihàn ìyípadà kankan nínú bí ọ̀rá àti bí hòmóònù ṣe pọ̀ tó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe imiphumela yabo ihambisana nalokho abanye abacwaningi abaningi abaye bakuthola, kodwa bangeze ukuthi ezinye izifundo azikho izinguquko kumanani amafutha namahomoni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sakamakon nasu ya yi daidai da abin da wasu masu bincike da yawa suka gano, amma sun ƙara da cewa wasu binciken da aka yi sun nuna babu wani canji a yawan kitse da sinadarai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipoelo tša bona di nyalelana le tšeo banyakišiši ba bangwe ba bantši ba di hweditšego, eupša ba tlaleleditše ka gore dinyakišišo tše dingwe ga se tša laetša diphetogo go dikelo tša makhura le dihomoune.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት ውጤቶቻቸው ሌሎች ብዙ ተመራማሪዎች ካገኙት ጋር ይመሳሰላል። ነገር ግን ሌሎች ጥናቶች በቅባቶች እና በሆርሞኖች መጠን ላይ ምን ለውጥ እንዳሳዩ አክለዋል።

English: Scientists do already know, however, that the relationship between fats, hormones and breast cancer is a complex one.
Luganda: Wabula, bannassaayansi bakimanyi bulungi nti, enkolagana wakati w’amasavu, homoni ne kookolo w’amabeere nzibu okutaggulula.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì ti mọ̀, síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, pé ìbáṣepọ̀ tí ó wà láàárín ọ̀rá, hòmóònù àti àrùn jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn jẹ́ èyí tó le púpọ̀.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, ososayensi sebeyazi ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwamafutha, amahomoni kanye nomdlavuza webele buyinkimbinkimbi.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya sun riga sun sani, duk da haka, cewa dangantakar da take tsakanin kitse da ƙwayoyin halitta da ciwon sankarar nono abu ne mai rikitarwa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, ditsebi tša mahlale di šetše di tseba gore kamano magareng ga makhura, dihomoune le kankere ya letswele e hlakahlakane kudu.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ሳይንቲስቶች በቅባቶች፣ በሆርሞኖች እና በጡት ካንሰር መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት ውስብስብ እንደሆነ ቀድሞውኑ ያውቃሉ።

English: For example, high levels of some hormones can lead to others, like progesterone, being lower.
Luganda: Okugeza, obungi bw’obusimu obumu obwa waggulu busobola okuviirako ebintu ebirala, gamba nga progesterone okubeera wansi.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, ìpèlè gíga hòmóònù kọ̀ọ̀kan lè fa kí àwọn míràn, bí pirojẹstiróònù, wá sílẹ̀.
Zulu: Isibonelo, amazinga aphezulu amanye amahomoni angaholela ekubeni amanye, njenge-progesterone, abe phansi.
Hausa: Misali, yawan matakan ƙwayoyin halitta na iya haifar da wasu, kamar ƙwayoyin sarrafa haila, kasancewa ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, dikelo tša godimo tša tše dingwe tša dihomoune di ka baka gore tše dingwe, tše swanago le phorotšeseterone, di be fasana.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ የአንዳንድ ሆርሞኖች ከፍተኛ መጠን እንደ ፕሮጄስትሮን ያሉ ሌሎች ሆርሞኖች አነስተኛ እንዲሆኑ ሊያደርጉ ይችላሉ።

English: More research may therefore be needed on the effect that fats, hormones and cancer cells have on one another, and how this might be used to diagnose breast cancer early.
Luganda: Noolwekyo okunoonyereza okulala kuyinza okwetaagibwa okukolebwa okuzuula buli kimu ku masavu, homoni n’obutaffaali bwa kookolo kye kikola ku kirala, n’engeri kino gye kisobola okukozesebwa okuzuula amangu kookolo w’amabeere.
Yoruba: Ìṣàmúlò púpọ̀ iṣẹ́ ìwádìí máa wa lórí ipa tí òrá, hòmóònù àti sẹ́ẹ̀lì jẹjẹrẹ ní lórí ara wọn, àti bí wọn ṣe lè lo èyí fún ìdámọ̀ jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn ní kíá.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke kungase kudingeke ucwaningo olwengeziwe mayelana nomthelela amafutha, amahomoni namangqamuzana omdlavuza okuba nawo komunye nomunye, nokuthi lokhu kungasetshenziswa kanjani ukuhlonza umdlavuza webele kusenesikhathi.
Hausa: Don haka, ana iya buƙatar ƙarin bincike a kan tasirin kitse, ƙwayoyin halitta da ƙwayoyin kansa na juna, da kuma yadda za a iya amfani da wannan don gano cutar sankarar nono da wuri.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona go ka hlokega gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tši ntši ka ditlamorago tšeo makhura, dihomoune le disele tša kankere di nago le tšona kamanong le tše dingwe, le ka moo seo se ka šomišwago go utolla kankere ye letswele e sa le ka pela.
